About the internship

Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include:
Key responsibilities:

1. Develop, maintain, and update WordPress websites (3 or more)
2. Build new pages, features, and website sections
3. Fix bugs and manage plugins, themes, and integrations
4. Ensure websites are responsive, secure, and optimised
5. Monitor website performance, uptime, backups, and technical issues
6. Implement SEO, speed, and UI improvements
7. Maintain basic technical documentation and website reports

About Apni Pathshala

Website
Apni Pathshala is a non-profit organization dedicated to transforming education through a decentralized model. We empower community leaders by providing resources like computers to establish micro-schools, homeschools, or alternative learning spaces. Focused on digital literacy, skill development, and community-based learning, our mission is to create self-sustaining educational ecosystems tailored to local community needs while fostering innovation and inclusion.
